title: Customer-driven custom quant-profile tuning and regression harness for FP8→INT8 path
creator: Lina Cheng
description: Enterprise finance customer requested an exception to the standard FP8 profile to migrate a proprietary risk model to an INT8 serving target. The model shows a 2.6% mean AUC regression when using the default INT8 profile in our staging quant pipeline. Customer needs a bespoke calibration run and a custom quantization profile (scale/clamp overrides and per-layer symmetric asymmetric settings) to meet their SLA for prediction accuracy. This ticket scopes the ad-hoc calibration job, the regression harness, and delivery of an auditable artifact + rollback plan for the private deployment (VPC).
technical_notes:
Summary of technical approach:
- Reproduce customer inference on internal calibration harness with same tokenization and preprocessing pipeline.
- Run FP8 baseline -> INT8 conversion path with per-layer statistics collection.
- Implement targeted per-layer override for attention projection and final linear layer; explore asymmetric quantization for embedding tables.
- Generate 3 candidate quant profiles (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and run deterministic eval suite.
Tradeoffs: aggressive quant reduces cost but risks regression; conservative keeps quality but minimal cost benefit. Kernel paths: verify fallback kernel for layers flagged incompatible with int8 fast-path. Ensure KV cache compatibility for deployment.
Important: model artifact and debug traces must be stored to S3 with customer-approved retention and redaction applied to PII-containing samples.
test_plan:
1) Re-run calibration on local harness with customer sample set (N=5k).
2) Run full regression harness: 5 random seeds, compute AUC/accuracy/ROUGE (where applicable), 95% CI.
3) Compare to FP8 baseline and customer-provided golden.
4) Run end-to-end latency and token-cost measurement in Dedicated staging pool.
5) Smoke deploy to a single private node using canary rollout and validate live traffic using sampled slices.
Acceptance thresholds: mean AUC regression <= 0.5% vs FP8 baseline, 99.9th latency within SLA, no new model-safety flags.
rollback_plan:
If candidate profile fails production slice:
- Revert routing to FP8 baseline profile immediately via rollout policy.
- Invalidate profile artifacts in model catalog and remove canary tag.
- Notify customer and open a follow-up with additional calibration constraints.
- Preserve logs and traces for postmortem.
roll_forward_plan:
If candidate meets thresholds:
- Promote balanced profile to staging and schedule phased rollout (10%→50%→100%) with 24h watch windows.
- Monitor quality regression alerts and cost delta; hold if either exceeds thresholds.
- Deliver signed calibration report and profile JSON to customer and update model catalog entry with profile metadata and author.
- Schedule a 30-day post-rollout review with customer for signed acceptance.
